verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents a built-in AI Assistant, its "AI email executive assistant", which can read threads, write drafts, search the entire email history and check the calendar. The assistant connects to business apps via built-in integrations and MCP for complex workflows inside the inbox, is backed by selectable Claude model tiers, and can browse the web. Triggers let it draft replies and organize threads automatically. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant's task-delegation quality (community evidence predates the AI features and does not address it).
